title: Site Security
subtitle: Known vulnerabilities in what the sites on this server actually run.
domainSubtitle: Known vulnerabilities in what this site actually runs.

status.title: Last scan
status.unparsedNote: Some versions could not be compared against the advisory ranges, so those packages were neither cleared nor reported. This is not a clean bill of health for them.
status.failedNote: The last scan did not finish. What it had already found is kept, but the sweep is incomplete.

inventory.title: What was inspected
inventory.note: One row per installation the last scan looked at. An installation with no findings is the good news this list exists to show: the findings list above cannot say on its own whether anything was checked at all.
inventory.empty: No installation has been inspected yet.
inventory.unscannedNote: These domains have no inspected installation at all. That is expected for a static site with no WordPress, npm or Composer installation, and it is a warning for anything else.

advisoryNote: These findings are advisory. Version matching against a public feed is not exact, so check an advisory before acting on it. Nothing here suspends an account or changes a file.
scheduleNote: The server scans every six hours. An administrator can also start a scan.

errors.load: The findings could not be loaded
errors.scan: The scan could not be started
errors.inventory: The inventory could not be loaded

domainTable.note: Every domain on the server, with the status of its last scan. Click a domain to see its findings.
